content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 alert - gateway-proxy: elevated 5xx + upstream timeouts. First seen 2025-11-03T14:07:14Z. Error rate jumped from ~1.2% -> 28% in last 6m. Affected route: /api/v1/generate -> gateway-proxy -> model-srv cluster. Paging oncall.
maya (oncall): on it. grabbing context and paging infra. tagging #incidents. Anyone who made outbound LB/envoy changes in last 6h?
raj: I made a small traffic reweight for canary earlier today (08:40UTC). I moved 20% -> 40% to canary for route /api/v1/generate to validate latency. Will check commits.
sara: seeing p95 spike and 504s from upstream. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/dashboard/xyz 5xx count graph and traces attached. p50 latency ~170ms -> 450ms. Errors correlate with increased requests hitting canary instances (model-srv-canary).
maya (oncall): Thanks. @raj can you paste the rollout/change id and the canary config? We should consider immediate rollback if it's correlated.
raj: commit: 3f9a7b2. Rollout note: gateway-config: traffic-split for /api/v1/generate: stable=60, canary=40. I used the automated rollout tool: redwoodctl rollout apply gateway-config --ref=3f9a7b2
infra-bot: Detected recent config change: gateway-config (3f9a7b2) by raj at 2025-11-03T08:40:12Z. Source: continuous-deploy/rollouts. No healthcheck failures reported at time of rollout.
maya (oncall): OK plan: 1) temporarily divert traffic back to previous weights (stable 95, canary 5) 2) disable client-side retries/hedging for the route to avoid amplification 3) monitor 5xx and latency. Any objections?
ops-lead: +1 on disabling retries as a quick mitigation, but rolling weight first might surface fewer errors sooner. We need to avoid broad outage.
raj: I'll roll weights back now. Command: ```redwoodctl rollout set-weight gateway-config --route "/api/v1/generate" --stable 95 --canary 5 --reason "emergency rollback - 5xx spike"``` Running...
raj: (runs) response: rollout accepted, target applied to control plane. Propagation to data plane should be <30s.
infra-bot: Config push: gateway-config v3f9a7b2 -> v3f9a7b2-rollback applied at 2025-11-03T14:10:03Z. Checked envoy stats on one node: envoy_admin:/stats | upstream_rq_5xx: dropped from 1200/s -> 210/s over 40s window.
sara: Metrics update: 5xx dropping. Current 5xx rate now ~3.8% (was ~28%). p95 down to 190ms. Traces show fewer timeouts to model-srv-canary.
jordan: Also saw increased envoy cluster retries causing upstream flood. Suggest removing retry-on-5xx for this route while we investigate. It's a cheap toggle.
maya (oncall): Good catch. @raj can you patch route retry policy? Example patch: ```kubectl -n gateway patch configmap envoy-routes -p '{"data":{"/api/v1/generate":"retry_policy: none"}}'``` or use redwoodctl to set route policy.
raj: Patching retry policy now via redwoodctl: ```redwoodctl config set gateway-config --route "/api/v1/generate" --patch '{"retry_policy":"disabled"}'``` Applying...
infra-bot: Retry policy updated on route /api/v1/generate at 2025-11-03T14:12:27Z. Active retries decreased dramatically on data plane.
sara: After both weight rollback and retry disable, 5xx stabilized ~1.5% and tail latencies recovered. Customer impact looks limited and falling.
client-success: Heads up: CS -> notified top 8 affected customers. Primary symptom: intermittent 500/504 for ~8-20m window depending on route. No data corruption. Escalations: 2 customers reported degraded UX; we sent initial note.
maya (oncall): Nice mitigation. Next: collect logs/traces for failing upstreams, correlate with canary instance logs (model-srv-canary). Raj/Sara to take ownership of root-cause.
raj: Pulling envoy config dumps and upstream logs. Command: ```curl -s http://gateway-pod:9901/config_dump | jq '.configs[] | select(.name=="rds")' > /tmp/rds.json``` Looking for route-level retry and shadow config.
sara: Found that canary model-srv was returning 502 on heavy sequences due to resource exhaustion (OOM-kills recently reported). Canary autoscaler threshold was too aggressive. Logs: ```model-srv-canary stderr: OOMKilled at 2025-11-03T13:59:11Z - java.lang.OutOfMemoryError```
ops-lead: That explains the retries/amplification. If canary instances are flaky, routing more traffic amplifies upstream errors and triggers LB circuit behavior.
maya (oncall): Agreed. Current mitigation: weight rollback + retries disabled. Action items: - raj: create PR to add preflight autoscaler checks before traffic bump (owner raj) - sara: investigate canary memory config and fix (owner sara) - ops-lead: update runbook to include retry-disable step and gating checks (owner ops-lead)
raj: Created task INC-3245: "add canary preflight and traffic gating for gateway-config". PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/782
sara: Created task INC-3246: "adjust model-srv-canary memory and add graceful failover". Will attach logs.
client-success: We're drafting a customer follow-up note: short summary, time window 14:07 - 14:18 UTC, affected endpoints, remediation steps, and the mitigation in place. ETA to customers: 30m.
maya (oncall): Handing off monitoring to Raj for the next 2 hours. I'll sleep-walk and watch alerts for final sign-off. If 5xx holds <1% for 30m, we'll close the incident and start postmortem.
jordan: +1. I'll schedule a quick post-incident review and invite relevant folks.
maya (oncall): final note: root cause likely mis-tuned canary autoscaling combined with aggressive traffic bump and retries causing amplification and circuit breaker noise. Postmortem to confirm. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated at 2025-11-03T14:18:54Z. Impact window: 11m. Tasks created: INC-3245, INC-3246, INC-3247 (runbook update). Oncall handoff -> raj."
